title: Obsolete
summary: OBSOLE'TE, adjective [Latin obsoletus.] 1. Gone into disuse; disused; neglected; as an obsolete word; an obsolete statute; applied chiefly to words or writings. 2. In botany, obscure; not very distinc

inlines.v: OBSOLE'TE, adjective [Latin obsoletus.] 1. Gone into disuse; disused; neglected; as an obsolete word; an obsolete statute; applied chiefly to words or writings. 2. In botany, obscure; not very distinct.
